radius.$description: Corner radii, on the same ladder as `space`, and the radius of each kind of shape. westron rounds corners at about a quarter of a control's height; a capsule uses the platform's capsule shape, not a radius. On Apple corners are continuous (decisions/0013).

25.$description: Step 25 of the radius ladder: 2 px.

50.$description: Step 50 of the radius ladder: 4 px.

75.$description: Step 75 of the radius ladder: 6 px.

100.$description: Step 100 of the radius ladder: 8 px.

150.$description: Step 150 of the radius ladder: 12 px.

200.$description: Step 200 of the radius ladder: 16 px.

300.$description: Step 300 of the radius ladder: 24 px.

400.$description: Step 400 of the radius ladder: 32 px.

control.$description: A control westron draws: a button, a field, a segmented control. 8 px, a quarter of a 32 px control.

row.$description: The highlight of a row under the pointer or selected.

card.$description: A card or a panel on the canvas.

overlay.$description: A popover or a menu westron draws; system ones keep their own.

sheet.$description: A sheet or a dialog westron draws.
